Definition: properly, to dig; figuratively, to plot; generally, to bore or open
BiblicalUsage: 1) to dig, excavate, dig through; 1a) (Qal) to dig; 1b) (Niphal) to be dug; 2) (Qal) to give a banquet or feast; 3) (Qal) to get by trade, trade, buy
